text: A merchant earns its states the same way.

text: Here is how it works.

text: First, the merchant uploads its company documents.

text: The bank must know who it does business with.

text: This is know your business.
prefix: This is know your business.

text: Each file goes into the file store.
prefix: Each file goes into the file store.

text: The store reads each file's real type from the file's own contents, never from its name.
prefix: The store reads each file's real type from the file's own contents, never from its name.

text: So a file called "charter" that is really something else is refused.
prefix: So a file called "charter" that is really something else is refused.

text: The store also keeps a checksum: a fingerprint worked out from every byte of the file.
prefix: The store also keeps a checksum: a fingerprint worked out from every byte of the file.

text: When the file is read back, its fingerprint must still match, so a changed file is caught.
prefix: When the file is read back, its fingerprint must still match, so a changed file is caught.

text: Next, a bank admin checks every document.
prefix: Next, a bank admin checks every document.

text: Each one is verified, or rejected with a reason the merchant can read and fix.

text: Only when every required document is verified can the company itself be verified.
prefix: Only when every required document is verified can the company itself be verified.

text: Then it signs a contract, and the contract carries its own unique number.
prefix: Then it signs a contract, and the contract carries its own unique number.

text: No two merchants ever share one.

text: Every move between states is written down: from where, to where, who, and why.

text: That record is the status history, and it is written in the same step as the move itself.
